payload.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Has the image been transformed into a drawing made from chalk?
node.criteria: complete: the image as a whole reads as a coherent chalk drawing, with a consistent chalk-medium appearance across the subject and surrounding scene; grain, smudging, or softened outlines alone do not establish completion if the image still reads partly as a stylized photograph or image. partial: visible progress toward a chalk drawing, such as a chalk-like texture or sketch treatment, but the overall image does not yet read as a fully realized chalk drawing. absent: no visible progress toward a chalk drawing. unknown: evidence is insufficient to determine progress or completion. Unrelated edits do not count as progress.
node.binding: Target: the image. Reference: a drawing made from chalk.

outcome.description: Transform the image into a chalk drawing.
